title: CAMPAIGN_TRANSITION -- one append-only, digest-chained lifecycle step
description: Every transition names the prior and next state, binds the campaign id and package commit, binds the authorizing approval or receipt digest, carries its input/output digests, and chains to the previous transition's sha256. transition_sha256 = sha256 over the canonical record bytes (sort_keys, ensure_ascii, compact separators) with transition_sha256 set to the empty string. The first record's prev_transition_sha256 is 64 zeros. Verified independently by exec/campaign_state.verify_transition_chain.

binding_kind.description: what authorizes this step: e.g. execution_approval, container_prep_receipt, dataset_manifest, selected_layer_receipt, protected_lock_receipt, campaign_receipt

utc.description: SYNTHETIC in conformance mode (replay-identical chains); ISO-8601 in real mode
